senses.gloss: m. (נוּעַ) the effort made to remove phlegm, hawking; the phlegm discharged by hawking, contrad. to כִּיחַ.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 7:1">Nidd. VII, 1</cite> <he>הנ׳ והרוק</he> the phlegm (of an unclean person) and the spittle.
<cite ref="Niddah 55b:57">Ib. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>ונִיעוֹ</he>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 3b:4">B. Kam. 3ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00517"><he>כִּיחַ</he></cite>; a. e.
